subject: Acme: VM evidence handoff and CVE remediation timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Owens <j.owens@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: recent VM scan artifacts + CVE timeline

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. Acme's compliance team is consolidating evidence for a quarterly SIG review and asked for:

- Most recent external and internal vulnerability scan artifacts for the Redwood environment that hosts our tenant (preferably the raw JSON/CSV export).
- A short attestation that CVE-2025-3141 has been triaged and the remediation owner + ETA.
- Confirmation of our agreed patch SLA and the cadence of scans (weekly vs. monthly).

Can you send the files or point me to a shared folder? We need to include this in the packet by EOD Tuesday (2025-08-19).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Owens
Security Program Manager, Acme Corporation
security@acme-corp.com

--
Note: Jordan included the enterprise compliance inbox on cc for recordkeeping.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Jordan Owens <j.owens@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: recent VM scan artifacts + CVE timeline

Folks — forwarding Acme's request. TL;DR: they need the latest scan exports, a brief attestation for CVE-2025-3141, and confirmation of our scan cadence / SLA. Target delivery: EOD Tue (19 Aug).

Alex — can you drop the raw scan JSON from the 8/15 run and a one-paragraph summary of findings?
Naomi — can you produce a signed SLA attestation PDF and include the remediation commitment language for critical/important CVEs? We should call out the committed windows (critical: 7 days, high: 30 days, medium/low: standard cadence) and confirm Acme is on the standard customer tier.

Cc'ing Evelyn for visibility on the request deadline + to make sure legal doesn't need to sign off on any wording.

If we miss Tuesday, ask for a 48-hour extension but aim for EOD.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jordan Owens <j.owens@acme.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme: VM evidence handoff and CVE remediation timeline

Karthik / Jordan — attaching the raw export from the internal and external scans run on 2025-08-15.

Summary:
- External (authenticated): 2 findings, both medium severity; no publicly-exploitable remote code execution vectors.
- Internal (agent-based): CVE-2025-3141 appears in host-image-layer scan at medium/important classification due to outdated package (libhttpd v2.4.8).
- No active exploitation indicators observed in logs tied to the flagged hosts.

Action taken: a temporary mitigation (WAF rule) was applied to block the vulnerable path while patching is scheduled. Patch plan attached for the specific hosts.

Attachments: acme_vm_scan_20250815.json, cve-2025-3141-patch-note.pdf

Let me know if you need a different export format.

- Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai

[attachment: acme_vm_scan_20250815.json (Vulnerability scan export, 1.2 MB)]
[attachment: cve-2025-3141-patch-note.pdf (patch steps and affected host list)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Owens <j.owens@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme: VM evidence handoff and CVE remediation timeline

Jordan / Karthik — attached is our signed SLA attestation for vulnerability management for customers on the Standard tier (Acme). The attestation includes:

- Scan cadence: internal agent scans weekly; external authenticated scans weekly; incremental scans on deploys.
- SLA windows: Critical/vuln with CVSS >=9.0: response & remediation plan within 7 calendar days; High (7.0-8.9): remediation plan within 30 calendar days; Medium/Low: scheduled per normal patch cycle (next maintenance window).
- Evidence retention: raw scan artifacts retained for 12 months; summary reports retained 36 months.
- Contact & escalation path: security@redwood.ai and RedTeam on-call.

I have also included the explicit attestation language regarding CVE-2025-3141: "Redwood confirms CVE-2025-3141 has been triaged, a mitigation control (WAF rule) implemented on 2025-08-15, and a host-level patch scheduled 2025-08-20 with verification to follow by 2025-08-21."

Attachment: redwood_vm_sla_attestation_20250819.pdf

If Acme wants the attestation on letterhead, we can generate that — please advise.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Trust & Security Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

[attachment: redwood_vm_sla_attestation_20250819.pdf (signed PDF)]

From: Jordan Owens <j.owens@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme: VM evidence handoff and CVE remediation timeline

Naomi / Alex — received, thanks. The attestation text and the scan export are sufficient for our SIG packet. A couple of asks before we close the ticket:

1) Can you include a short verification note once the host-level patch has been applied and the post-patch internal scan shows the finding cleared? A single-sentence verification with timestamp is fine.
2) Please confirm whether the WAF mitigation was applied solely to Acme tenant traffic or globally to edge rules. If global, we need an impact statement for other customers.

If you can get the verification note by end of 2025-08-21 that will close our item. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Jordan
Jordan Owens
Security Program Manager, Acme Corporation
j.owens@acme.com
